instruction: Cinematic low-angle wide shot of an indoor gym. On the left, the shirtless man with short dark hair (R1) sits on the floor, facing right. On the right, the shirtless bearded man with a shoulder tattoo (R3) kneels, facing left. They smile at each other while clasping right hands in a firm handshake. A strong warm backlight shines between them, casting a bright flare against a dark background with a knight mural.

R1 and R3 clasp each other's right hands while facing one another
